g.text: Citizens Advice Wandsworth • Case Ace v2.0
End-to-End Data Flow, Security Boundaries & Zero-Retention Cloud Architecture
Volatile RAM Heap Only • Zero Disk Writes • Storage Guards Active
Uncompressed audio in volatile browser RAM • 0 disk caching
• Invariant C1/C7: Line-rate zeroing via Uint8Array.fill(0)
Local Web Worker execution • 0 network calls for transcription
• Generates initial unredacted transcript entirely on client CPU
Layer 1: Regex (NINO, Tel, Postcode, Bank Account, DOB)
Layer 2: Local Transformer NER (Names, Orgs) • Layer 3: Context Rules
Dictionary Map stored in isolated memory closure • Never leaves RAM
Adviser visually inspects tokenised spans & clicks to add missed entities
• Mandatory active sign-off before cloud synthesis is unlocked
Aligns token timestamps • Overwrites PII audio segments with silence
• Raw audio zeroed • Fail-closed assertion: 0 unredacted survivors
• Produces sanitized LINEAR16 WAV for second-pass STT
Receives draft note with surrogate tokens • In-memory dictionary swap
• Re-inserts real names locally in client browser memory
• Adviser validates technical advice, edits gaps, and clicks 'Sign Off'
• Deletes token map dictionary & transcript strings
• Terminates Web Workers & drops WebCrypto subtle keys
• Clipboard buffer wiped on exit • Zero persistent residue
• Triggered on: Finish, Logout, Timeout, Consent Revocation, Tab Close
Google Cloud Run (europe-west2 London) • Stateless Broker
Webex Telephony Webhook Ingest & RBAC Validation
Validates HMAC-SHA256 signatures • Enforces Entra ID group roles
• Zero audio persists on backend • Direct TLS 1.3 proxy to browser
Pinned to London Region • Zero Data Retention (ZDR) Legal Terms
Receives ONLY Verified Redacted Audio (LINEAR16 WAV)
• Second-pass high accuracy ASR • All PII audio spans are muted silence
• Scoped 15-min STS auth • Zero persistent audio storage
• Zero data retained • No prompt logging • No model retraining
